key_insight: ARDY combines autoregressive generation with diffusion and a hybrid motion representation to make interactive human motion synthesis both fast and controllable. The core breakthrough is preserving real-time responsiveness without giving up rich text conditioning and long-horizon motion coherence.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the gap between offline motion generators that are controllable but too slow for interactive use, and online methods that are fast but often lose fidelity, semantic understanding, or long-term consistency.
method: Uses an autoregressive framework to generate motion step-by-step for interactive, low-latency synthesis.
Integrates diffusion-based generation to improve motion realism and diversity under user guidance.
Employs a hybrid representation to better capture both local kinematics and higher-level motion structure for long-horizon coherence.
impact: This matters for practitioners building animation tools, embodied AI systems, and humanoid robots because it enables responsive motion generation that can still follow complex instructions. It points toward practical real-time controllers that are more expressive and reliable in interactive settings.

paper_title: ARDY: Autoregressive Diffusion with Hybrid Representation for Interactive Human Motion Generation
paper_authors: Kaifeng Zhao, Mathis Petrovich, Haotian Zhang, Tingwu Wang, Siyu Tang
